records.text: Jennifer Kay reported that Grok called Israel-Egypt intelligence cooperation unprecedented and said that since the 1979 peace treaty their intelligence chiefs have met often and shared real-time data.
records.speaker: Jennifer Kay (commenter; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Just asked Grok if Israel and Egypt coordinate on intelligence ops. It says yes, calling their cooperation unprecedented. Since the 1979 peace treaty, intel chiefs have met often, share real-time data

verification.notes: The episode confirms that Owens read a viewer message from Jennifer Kay attributing this wording to Grok. The original Grok interaction is not available to reproduce, so the precise citation cannot be fully authenticated. Independent reporting supports the substance that Israel and Egypt have engaged in unusually close intelligence sharing and that their intelligence chiefs have met repeatedly, but it does not establish uninterrupted frequent meetings and real-time data sharing throughout the entire period since the 1979 treaty. The attribution is therefore partly verified and the broader historical wording only partly supported.
